newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two banks to inject funds into Chiyoda Life--paper.
newsitem.headline: Two banks to inject funds into Chiyoda Life--paper.

text.p: Tokai Bank Ltd and Asahi Bank Ltd each plan to extend 20 billion yen in loans to Chiyoda Mutual Life Insurance Co to help Chiyoda to increase its capital base, Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Saturday.
Chiyoda and the two banks were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this month, Chiyoda said it would raise funds totalling 50 billion yen to boost its capital base to 51 billion yen from the current one billion yen.
A Chiyoda spokesman said at that time that the fund-raising plan was expected to strengthen its capital.
